description.en: A lemon cake recipe from Elaine C. Atlow's personal collection, written on her personal stationery. The cake is baked in a loaf pan at 375°F for about 30 minutes, and can be used with a filling.
description.he: מתכון לעוגת לימון מהאוסף האישי של אליין סי אטלו, כתוב על הנייר המכתבים האישי שלה. העוגה נאפית בתבנית אורכית ב-375 מעלות פרנהייט במשך כ-30 דקות, וניתן להשתמש גם עם מילוי.

en: Slowly mix in flour and dry ingredients. Should be blended with flour.
Pour batter into a loaf pan, a 3" deep long one, or it will be too thick.
Add lemon rind for one kind.
Keep seeds and use a strainer.
Fresh lemon peel is best. Bake 375.
One cookie or so, maybe 30 min.
For effect, use chocolate for filling. Can use.
he: לערבב לאט את הקמח והמרכיבים היבשים. צריך להתמזג עם הקמח.
לשפוך את הבלילה לתבנית אורכית, עמוקה כ-7.5 ס"מ, אחרת תהיה עבה מדי.
קליפת לימון טרייה היא הכי טובה. לאפות ב-375 מעלות.

ocrRawText:
FROM THE DESK OF: ELAINE C. ATLOW

Lemon Cake
1⅓ C flour
1½ t baking powder
¼ C margarine
¾ C sugar
Blend, 1 tsp vanilla
1 egg

Cream marg., sugar. Add
egg. Slowly mix in flour and
dry ingredients. Should be
blended with flour.
Pour into a long pan, a 3" deep
long one or it will be too thick.
Add lemon rind for one kind.
Keep seeds and use a strainer.
Fresh lemon peel is best. Bake 375.
One cookie or so maybe 30 min.
For effect, use chocolate for filling.
Can use.
rankingReason: Result B demonstrates significantly better OCR accuracy and recipe coherence. It correctly identifies the title as 'Lemon Cake' (with actual lemon ingredients listed), properly reads quantities for flour (1⅓ cup) and baking powder (1½ tsp) that were missing in Result A, and extracts meaningful instructions about lemon rind/peel that align with the title. Result A misinterprets '1/3' as '1⅓ C. Baking Powder' (an implausibly large amount), omits flour quantities, and contains a title-ingredient mismatch (Lemon Delight with no lemon). Result B's Hebrew translations are more natural and contextually appropriate, and the recipe as a whole is more coherent and executable.
